zones.label: Unknown Strength
zones.summary: Unregulated products may contain unexpected ingredients or strength.

zones.label: Mixed Effects
zones.summary: Combining substances can amplify, mask, or change effects.
facts: Feeling less impaired does not mean the body is safer.
Effects vary by person and timing.

zones.label: Medication Interactions
zones.summary: Alcohol, drugs, supplements, and medicines can interact.
facts: Prescription use and misuse are different.
Ask a pharmacist or clinician about interactions.

zones.label: Overdose Warning
zones.summary: Unresponsiveness, slow or stopped breathing, blue or gray skin, seizure, or severe confusion require emergency action.
facts: Do not leave the person alone.

zones.label: Get Help
zones.summary: Call emergency services and involve a trusted adult immediately.
facts: Share what may have been taken without fear of judgment.
Use naloxone when opioid overdose is possible and training or local guidance supports it.
